title: Anchor Marine reports busier berths at Tolan Harbour

facts.subject: Tolan Harbour
facts.statement: Anchor Marine says Tolan Harbour is handling more wheat cargoes from Vanir as Tolan buyers replace some Orvan supply.

source_ref.text_snippet: Anchor Marine says Tolan Harbour is handling more wheat cargoes from Vanir as Tolan buyers replace some Orvan supply.

facts.subject: Orvan sea route
facts.statement: It expects the pattern to continue while Orvan's sea route is disrupted.

facts.statement: The company has not raised its fees for the additional shift.
